understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, while avoiding spike tiles and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions cause automatic movement in the current gravity direction until landing, hitting a hazard, reaching the goal, or changing section. The structured landing previews and corridor scan identify safe destinations and passage columns. CLICK at a target coordinate removes clickable breakable blocks without advancing the rising-platform timer, allowing blocked gravity paths to open. Landing on spikes ends the attempt; each level provides two attempts with a turn limit. UNDO reverts the previous action and can recover from a mistaken move or click.
